title: fix(fields): the lookup picker fits the room it is given, marks a cut row, and lets option previews wrap
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9QSmT6s2ZTGps4fXHsTwFbT)_

Fixes #34362

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：查找字段快选弹层的选项列表不再固定 16rem 高：弹层不超过 Radix 报告的可用高度（搜索框保持高度，列表占剩余空间，上限仍是 16rem）；列表上下还有更多选项时，那一侧边缘渐隐，被切开的行读作「可继续滚动」；每个选项的副标题放不下时整列换到第二行（最多两行），不再把邮箱和所属客户一起截断；仍被截断的文本值悬停可见全文（title）。
- **为什么改**：实测根因不是对话框挡住了翻转。弹层本就 portal 到 body，Radix 在对话框里照常翻到空间更大的一侧；「只露 4½ 行、最后一行半截」是固定 16rem（256px）列表高度对上 56px 行高的必然结果，在哪里打开都一样，且没有任何滚动提示。窗口较矮、两侧都放不下时，弹层还会超出屏幕。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 `@object-ui/fields` 的 LookupField 弹层/列表/选项行，无契约与服务端改动；未改共享 `popover.tsx`。副标题由单行变为最多两行，选项行可能变高，16rem 内可见行数会减少（两行副标题时约 3½ 行）。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：① `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.tsx` 的 `fitPreviewLine`（换行、行数上限、换行列去掉分隔点、截断值写 title）；② 同文件 `PopoverContent` 与 listbox 的类名及 `listMore` 渐隐；③ 测试文件 `LookupField.previewBadges-13123.test.tsx` 改写的布局模型。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.previewBadges-13123.test.tsx`，预期 17 个测试全过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## Root cause (measured)

Measured in Chromium with the real `LookupField` and the real `Dialog`, bundled from source (the bundling of `e2e/permission-field-panel-scroll.spec.ts`, real Tailwind theme), inside a dialog with the action dialog's classes (`flex max-h-[90vh] flex-col`), at 1280×800, with ten contacts previewing Email and Account like the card's picker. The probe was a one-off and is not committed.

- **The popover does flip inside a dialog.** `PopoverContent` already renders through a Radix portal into `body`, so no dialog body clips it, and Radix's default `flip` measures against the viewport. With the field near the dialog's bottom (space below 259 / 179 / 121 px, above 501 / 581 / 639 px) the popover opened on top every time (`data-side="top"`), fully inside the viewport. No collision boundary and no portal problem.
- **The "4½ rows, last one cut mid-row" is the list's fixed `max-h-64`.** The list was 256 px whatever the room. An option with a one-line preview is 56 px tall, so the fifth row always showed 32 of its 56 px: its name, not its preview, exactly as the card describes, below or above the field alike, with nothing saying the list scrolls.
- **The cap also ignored the room it was given.** At 1280×480, with 179 px below and 261 px above, the 306 px popover flipped up and ran 49 px off the top of the screen (`--radix-popover-content-available-height` read 257 px; the list ignored it).
- **The subtitle cut both fields because it was one row.** Two text columns side by side each shrink to share one row, so `Email: emily.davis@starkmed.e…` and `Account: Stark Medic…` were both cut, and the account name that tells same-named contacts apart was lost.

After the fix, same probe: the popover still opens on top at 259 / 179 / 121 px below; at 1280×480 it is 257 px tall at `top: 0` (inside the viewport) with the list at 207 px; every preview shows the full email on its first row and the full account on its second; the cut row at the list's bottom sits under a fade.

## What changes

- `PopoverContent` (in `LookupField`, not the shared `popover.tsx`): `flex flex-col max-h-(--radix-popover-content-available-height)`. The search row, the error state and the loading state are `shrink-0`; the list (in a `relative flex min-h-0 flex-col` wrapper) is `max-h-64 min-h-0`, so it takes what the search row leaves, up to the same 16rem. Radix's default flip is kept: it still moves the popover to the side with more room whenever the whole popover does not fit below.
- Scroll cue: `listMore` tracks whether options continue above or below the list's visible box (read after every commit, on scroll, and from a `ResizeObserver` on the list, attached by a callback ref); each edge with more past it draws an `aria-hidden` gradient (`lookup-list-more-above` / `lookup-list-more-below`). The list carries `scroll-py-6`, so the arrow keys' `scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest' })` stops an option clear of the fade.
- Option preview: the line is `flex-wrap` (`gap-x-1 gap-y-0.5`). `fitPreviewLine` now hides trailing segments while the line overflows its width OR its shown segments span more than `LOOKUP_PREVIEW_MAX_ROWS` (2) rows, read off the segments' `offsetTop`. So a column that does not fit beside the one before it moves whole to the second row, and a column that does not fit in two rows leaves whole, with every column after it. A shown segment that opens a row hides its leading `·`. A text value (`data-lookup-preview-text`) whose box is narrower than its content gets its full text as `title`; one that fits has none. The objectui#13123 rules stand: a badge column never shrinks, a text value never shrinks below its label.
- The ORDER of the previewed columns is untouched: it is the app's authored config.
- Changeset: `.changeset/34362-lookup-picker-room.md` (`@object-ui/fields`: patch).

## Tests

All in the existing shared harness file `LookupField.previewBadges-13123.test.tsx` (jsdom has no layout, so the pins read classes, attributes and stubbed boxes, not pixels):

- New `describe('LookupField picker popover: bound to the room it is given (objectstack#34362)')`: the popover is portaled out of the field into Radix's popper wrapper; it carries `flex`, `flex-col` and `max-h-(--radix-popover-content-available-height)`; the search row is `shrink-0`; the list is `min-h-0 max-h-64 overflow-y-auto` in a `min-h-0` wrapper; the below / above fades follow a stubbed scroll box through scroll to the end and back; no fade when every option fits; the list carries `scroll-py-6`.
- New `describe('LookupField option preview: secondary columns stay told apart (objectstack#34362)')`: the line is `flex-wrap`; a column that opens the second row drops its separator, one beside its predecessor keeps it, and every separator stays on one row; a cut text value gets its full text as `title`, a whole one and a badge get none.
- **Forced edit to existing tests**, named: the layout model behind `describe('LookupField option preview: a column the line cannot hold leaves whole (objectui#13123)')` (renamed "…the rows cannot hold…") now wraps segments onto rows (`offsetTop` stubbed) instead of modelling one row, because the line now wraps. Its cases moved with the model: at 280 px all three columns show (revenue wraps to row two, was dropped); at 180 px status and industry show (one column a row, the third row is one too many; was status only); 600 px and 100 px are unchanged. The resize case now goes 180 → 600 → 100 px (`[status, industry]` → all → none). Every assertion of the three "badge never cut / text still truncates / segment whole" tests above it is unchanged.

## Acceptance notes

- None filed.
- The 16rem list cap is kept. With a two-row preview an option is 74 px, so about 3½ options show in 16rem where 4½ did; the fade marks the cut. Whether the cap should grow is a product call left open in the report, not made here.
- No docs page describes the typeahead's placement or preview layout (`content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx` describes the picker's features only), so no docs change is owed.
- `popover.tsx` (shared by every popover) is not touched: the cause was in the lookup's own list, not in the primitive.

## Verification

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/src/widgets/LookupField.previewBadges-13123.test.tsx` → Tests 17 passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/fields/ --maxWorkers=2` → Test Files 306 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 4633 passed, 7 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields run type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) → exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec eslint` on the two changed files → exit 0 (0 errors; the warnings are pre-existing lines). `pnpm --dir ui run check:new-line-citations` → 0 new citations.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, mutation proven on disk, each restored to HEAD blob 010d418f431b)</summary>

- A1 drop `max-h-(--radix-popover-content-available-height)` from the popover → "caps the popover…" red (1 failed / 16 passed).
- A2 drop `min-h-0` from the list → "caps the popover…" red (1 / 16).
- A3 `below:` always false → "marks the list edge…" red (1 / 16).
- A4 delete the row cap (`|| previewRowsOf(segments) > LOOKUP_PREVIEW_MAX_ROWS`) → the 180 px case and the resize case red (2 / 15).
- A5 delete `if (separator && opensRow) separator.hidden = true;` → "drops the separator…" red (1 / 16).
- A6 write no `title` on a cut value → "gives a text value cut short…" red (1 / 16).
- A7 drop `flex-wrap` → "lets the preview wrap…" red (1 / 16).

</details>
